newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASKO REPEATS SEES 1997 EARNINGS UP ON 1996.
newsitem.headline: ASKO REPEATS SEES 1997 EARNINGS UP ON 1996.

text.p: Finnish plastic pipes and furniture group Asko Oy repeated on Thursday it expected full-year 1997 earnings to show an improvement on 1996.
"The Asko Group's result before taxes and reserves is expected to show an improvement over the previous year," it said in a statement with its first tertial earnings.

Its January-April result after financial items rose to 76.9 million markka from 37.2 million and its pretax profit was 153.3 million markka -- including 76.4 million markka in extraordinary income -- compared to 23.3 million in the year-ago period.
